items.source: Inserts the given entity. Assumes the instance to be new to be able to apply insertion optimizations. Use the returned instance for further operations as the save operation might have changed the entity instance completely. Prefer using ReactiveCrudRepository.save(Object) instead to avoid the usage of store-specific API.
items.translation: 插入给定的实体。假定该实例为新建实例，以便应用插入优化。请使用返回的实例进行后续操作，因为保存操作可能会完全更改实体实例。建议改用 ReactiveCrudRepository.save(Object) 以避免使用特定于存储的 API。
